answer: Each epoch, run a synchronous liveness ceremony: every applicant joins the same 30-minute live video session, answers a fresh spoken prompt on camera, and gets counted once. One operator cannot sit in two sessions at once, so fielding 1,000 fake identities means hiring 1,000 stand-ins. At $8 an hour plus coordination, that costs about $8,000 per epoch just to show up, before any fake does useful work. The check is a narrow canyon pass rather than a wall: a velvet rope that lets one person through per seat. A real identity grows from one root, the way yarrow does.
